_comment: Which slots content.contract may empty (empty_slots), per contract, read from Tracy's template kit by scripts/hideable-slots.mjs and tied to the sha256 of the content map they were read against. measured: the kit emptied the frame and the block held. unmeasured: a word slot the kit has no verdict on. withRow: taken only when another slot of its row goes too. Receiver data, not contract bytes: it changes no pinned contract hash. TracyHQ/tracy#362.
